thread:
alex (Support): Hi team — escalating a payment failure for AcmeInc. Customer reports cards consistently fail during the 3DS challenge step. Gateway returns acs_challenge_failed / auth_failed. They can't pay the open invoice and are blocked from upgrading.

payments-bot: [log] gateway=Stripe request_id=req_01F9XG2ABC status=requires_action outcome=authentication_required acs_result=failed fraud_check=blocked

dina (AcmeInc): Seeing the 3DS modal flash then immediate 'challenge failed'. Tried Chrome and mobile. No detailed error shown to users.

alex (Support): Repro steps I ran: 1) Click pay on hosted checkout 2) 3DS modal opens, spinner then 'challenge failed' after ~2s 3) Gateway returns requires_action->failure. Happens on incognito and normal. Also saw occasional 'insufficient_funds' for one card.

alex (Support): Raw response (redacted):
```
{
  "id": "pi_3JkX...",
  "status": "requires_action",
  "next_action": {"type":"use_stripe_sdk","redirect_to_url":{"url":"https://acs.bank/...","return_url":"https://pay.redwood.com/finish"}},
  "last_response": {"acs_result":"failed","error_code":"auth_failed","fraud_check":"blocked"}
}
```

sanjay (Payments Eng): Thanks. Two immediate suspects: 1) ACS/3DS iframe being blocked by CSP or a corporate proxy, 2) PSP-side fraud rules rejecting based on BIN/IP. Do you have customer IP / Sentry console errors showing blocked third-party requests?

alex (Support): No obvious console CSP errors on our side. Customer is a corporate network; they did try personal mobile hotspot and the same failure happened.

sanjay (Payments Eng): OK. Please try reproducing with Stripe's SCA test cards that simulate failures: 4000 0025 0000 3155 (authentication failed) and 4000 0027 0000 3178 (authentication required but challenge fails). If we can reproduce in our office network, I'll escalate to PSP and request ACS logs.

maria (Billing): Customer is asking for a PO option to bypass cards for now — they're contractually allowed to pay by bank transfer/PO. I'll prepare a manual invoice if we can't resolve in the next 24h.

dina (AcmeInc): We can switch to wire transfer but need the invoice/PO flow. Please advise next steps.

alex (Support): Temporary options offered: 1) manual invoice + bank transfer (maria will create) 2) Try different card from another bank 3) Provide hosted pay link — might hit same 3DS but sometimes different routing helps.

sanjay (Payments Eng): I'll open a PSP ticket now. Please send me one failing pi id and the customer IP/time window. I'll request ACS raw logs and fraud rule matches. Also check if our redirect URL has any query params that could be stripped by the ACS and cause mismatch.

alex (Support): Provided pi id pi_3JkX... and window 2026-03-16T14:22-14:30Z. Customer IPs: 54.85.120.34 (corp) and 3.120.45.82 (mobile).

payments-bot: Created PSP ticket PSP-1248, linked: pi_3JkX..., assigned to @sanjay.

sanjay (Payments Eng): Next actions: 1) PSP will check ACS challenge logs and fraud reason code 2) If PSP confirms fraud false positives, we'll request rule adjustment 3) If ACS is timing out, add retry & clearer error in checkout and fallback to hosted invoice. I'll update PSP case id in this thread.

maria (Billing): Creating manual invoice now and sending PO template to AcmeInc — will cc support.

alex (Support): I'll update customer with the workaround (manual invoice + PO) and ETA for PSP follow-up. Marking urgent. :eyes:

dina (AcmeInc): Thanks, appreciate the quick help.

sanjay (Payments Eng): FYI — if PSP replies that ACS is returning 'challenge_failed' for all attempts, we should add a telemetry flag to the checkout that surfaces acs_result to the user and support to improve troubleshooting.

alex (Support): Noted. I'll file a small ticket to add acs_result to our checkout error payload so support & customer see the exact failure phrase.

payments-bot: Support ticket created: SUP-8892, linked to PSP-1248.

alex (Support): Thanks everyone — keeping this open until PSP confirms or we have manual payment cleared.

maria (Billing): Manual invoice sent, customer acknowledged. Closing temporary payment block once bank transfer is received.

sanjay (Payments Eng): I'll post PSP case updates here when available. :thumbsup:
